body: -gpt2-url flag activates GPT-2 policy at 4Hz (every 5 ticks); POST to /generate with state string, decode action tokens to UserCmd (fwd/str/yaw_delta/shoot/jump/weapon); 200ms timeout; falls back to heuristic on error. parseActionTokens() matches game_state.py encode_action format.
title: S39-04: GPT-2 policy in emily-bot
